info.name: Developer Assessment Platform API
info.description: Complete API collection for the B7A6 Developer Assessment Platform backend. Recommended workflow: login reviewer/candidate/admin -> reviewer creates assessment + two questions -> publish -> candidate enrolls -> Stripe payment -> start/save answers/submit -> reviewer claims/grades -> candidate reads result -> admin audits.

request.description: Use a real Google Identity Services ID token issued for GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.
Requires Cloudinary environment variables. Choose a JPEG/PNG/WebP file <=2MB in Postman.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Backend TypeScript Assessment",
  "slug": "backend-typescript-assessment",

  "durationMinutes": 60,
  "passingScore": 70,

request.description: Demonstration endpoint. Do not run this before the candidate workflow unless you add another text question.
Demonstration endpoint. Run only after the workflow is complete and no active attempts remain.
Requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in test mode. pm_card_visa is Stripe's test PaymentMethod identifier. A successful payment changes the attempt from PENDING_PAYMENT to READY.
Returns a Stripe clientSecret if you prefer client-side confirmation. Usually use either this request OR Initiate + Confirm Test Payment.
Use after initiating without a paymentMethodId.
Do not manually fake this request. Stripe signs the raw request body. Use: stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/payments/webhook and copy the generated whsec_... to STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
For paid assessments, run Stripe payment first; status must be READY.
Set targetUserId to a non-admin user ID before running.
Set targetUserId to a user with no active assessment work.
Set targetUserId to a non-admin user with no active assessment work.
